acs.text_first_line: AC1 A suggestion is stored as a proposal with its versions and nothing is approved
AC2 The 60 s wait ends and the rule result is used
AC3 A suggestion outside the band is flagged and routed to approval
AC4 An officer override is recorded with the suggestion it overrode
AC5 The same key asked twice writes once
AC6 A refusal leaves the treatment unchanged and the workflow retries
AC7 No personal data in the request, the answer, the event or the log
AC8 The proposal shows on SCR-15 through the composite route
